_comment: Fun / demo (non-clinical) phantom ingest manifest. See dev-docs/plans/DEMO_PHANTOMS_CLOTHED_AND_STEAMBOAT_PLAN.md. rotate_deg + flip_y are PLACEHOLDERS until per-mesh orientation discovery locks them (Tasks 2-5). height_axis is the raw-mesh axis (x|y|z) whose span is scaled to height_cm BEFORE the PSD transform. flip_y maps to transform_to_psd_frame: true -> force_flip_y=True; false -> force_flip_y=False AND flip_y_if_needed=False. face_up_frac defaults to 0.55 (superior 12% Z band); Cosmic Buddha is headless so it uses face_up_band_frac 0.20 (superior 20% robe/torso band). torso_z_fraction_range / baseline_torso_width_cm are optional GUI habitus overrides wired in Task 6. Mesh asset licenses are NOT tracked in dev-docs/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md (Python deps only).

cosmic_buddha.attribution: Smithsonian Institution (Freer Gallery of Art), 'Buddha draped in robes portraying the Realms of Existence'. CC0 public-domain dedication; SI credit encouraged but not required. Retrieved via the Wikimedia Commons 150k-face mirror (~7.5 MB), not the 2.88 GB full-resolution scan.
cosmic_buddha.geometry_notes: Standing draped figure ~151 cm; MISSING HEAD AND HANDS. Orientation LOCKED (2026-07-22) by depth-map discovery: raw axes already map to the PSD frame (raw Z=superior-inferior with crown/top at max Z, raw X=lateral, raw Y=anterior-posterior), so rotate_deg=[0,0,0] and height_axis=z. The carved 'realms' relief, arm/hand stubs, and scalloped robe hem are on the raw -Y face (anterior); the smooth back is +Y (posterior), so flip_y=false anchors the back to the table (y_max~=0) with the anterior toward -Y. No head means a weaker face-up cue: the face-up gate uses the superior 20% robe/torso band (face_up_band_frac=0.20); the raw mesh is already watertight (euler_number=2), so no hole-fill/Blender cap was needed.
cosmic_buddha.fallback_notes: Single CC0 SI source. If the open base cannot be capped by trimesh or Blender, drop this ID rather than weaken the watertight gate.

petite_herculanaise.attribution: Petite Herculanaise (Louvre, Paris) scan, Cults3D. CC BY-SA: attribution + ShareAlike required; the redistributed STL derivative stays SA-compatible (app code remains MIT).
petite_herculanaise.geometry_notes: Standing draped woman -> rotate upright->supine. NOTICE_petite_herculanaise.txt required (BY-SA).
petite_herculanaise.fallback_notes: Prefer Cults CC BY-SA source. MyMiniFactory 6356 only if the license panel is confirmed non-NC (abort if NC); record the exact license panel if used.

ramesses_ii.attribution: Colossal sculpture of Ramesses II, by Dejp3 (Wikimedia Commons). CC BY 4.0: attribution required.
ramesses_ii.geometry_notes: Recumbent/mounted colossal figure. Orientation LOCKED (2026-07-22) by depth-map discovery of the raw mesh: raw body (superior-inferior) axis = raw Y with the crown/nemes headdress at max Y and feet at min Y; raw X = lateral; raw Z = anterior-posterior with the carved face/body relief on raw +Z (anterior) and the flat museum mounting plate + plinth on raw -Z (posterior). rotate_deg=[90,0,0] (Rx +90 deg, sxyz) maps raw Y->+Z (crown at max Z), raw +Z (anterior)->-Y, raw -Z (posterior/mount)->+Y so the back anchors to the table (y_max~=0) face-up; height_axis=z is the post-rotation body axis (raw Y span ~=48.87 -> scaled to 185 cm, scale ~=3.785). flip_y=false: the Rx rotation already yields face-up, so no extra Y negation. WATERTIGHT REPAIR: the raw scan is NOT watertight (10 disconnected bodies, ~4438 open boundary edges, euler=17); fill_holes cannot close it, so voxel_pitch=5.5 cm triggers the solid-voxel + marching-cubes remesh (_voxel_remesh_watertight) which yields a single closed manifold (~5.6k faces <= target 6000, so quadric decimation is a no-op and watertightness survives). Final shipped height ~=192 cm (marching-cubes pads the bbox ~1 voxel per side; within the 170-200 cm target). Colossal/blocky proportions accepted per plan (smoke passes). NOTICE_ramesses_ii.txt required (BY). Raw STL ~25 MB stays under tmp/.

steamboat_willie.attribution: Steamboat Willie 3D model, by Adrian Cojocaru (Wikimedia Commons). CC BY 4.0: attribution required. US public-domain 1928 design; CC BY applies to the 3D mesh. TRADEMARK CAUTION: label stem 'steamboat_willie' only, never 'Mickey Mouse' / Disney affiliation.
steamboat_willie.geometry_notes: Cartoon figure ~120 cm. NOTICE_steamboat_willie.txt required (BY). Fill/cap + post-flip normal fix before and after decimate.
steamboat_willie.fallback_notes: Primary: Commons Cojocaru CC BY 4.0. If watertight repair fails, fall back to JoeBert Sketchfab CC-BY (~5.6k tris). Quaternius filler only if BOTH Steamboat sources entirely fail.
